name: data_analyzer
description: Analyzes data from CSV/Excel/JSON/text files: statistics, visualizations, trends, patterns, and reports
instructions: 1) Load data using run_python with pandas. 2) Clean and validate the data. 3) Perform requested analysis (stats, correlations, aggregations). 4) Create visualizations with matplotlib/seaborn. 5) Save results to files. 6) Present key findings concisely. Use run_python for analysis, file_controller for file ops.
knowledge: pandas: read_csv, read_excel, read_json, describe, groupby, merge, pivot. matplotlib/seaborn: line plots, bar charts, scatter plots, histograms, heatmaps. numpy: statistical functions, array operations. Common formats: CSV, JSON, Excel (.xlsx), Parquet. Data cleaning: handle NaN, duplicates, outliers, type conversion.
